Among the most joyous sounds in
popular music is that of the mellow,
full-voiced orchestra of Les Elgart cut-
ting loose on some fine old songs, and
that is exactly what this brand-new,
swinging collection consists of. Of all
the new bands to spring up since the
end of the war, none has been as eagerly
accepted by dancers of all types and
by listeners of even more varied de-
scription as the group that Les Elgart
has been heading for some five years.
As this sheaf of prime Elgart presen-
tations demonstrates, the band has a
bounce, a cleanliness, a smoothness
that is virtually irresistible, and it has
rarely sounded better in its per-
formances.
The happy conjunction of a fine
band and receptive audiences around
the country-the program is a com
pilation of segments of various dance
dates plaved by the band-sets up a
peculiar empathy that adds consider-
ably to the enjoyment of those of us
listening or dancing at home. More-
over, it gives special point to the care-
fully designed arrangements that dis-
play the orchestra as an ensemble and

Les Elgart and His Orchestra
markable in its blend of voicings (it
is perhaps the only major dance or-
chestra that has discarded the piano
in its arrangements) and today that
tone is richer and smoother than ever.
Les Elgart is an orchestra leader
with sound ideas, a phrase with a
double meaning (and one which has
also been used as the title of an earlier
collection). The ideas are musically
sound and soundly musical, and in ad-
dition there concerned with the
sonorities and colorings possible in the
relatively small instrumentation al-
lowed a dance orchestra. Within that
framework, the ideas - which are
young ideas as well- have been ap-
plied to some fine old songs that are
not too often heard these days, and the
result is as rewarding to listeners as
it is to dancers. The livelier numbers
are contagious in their happy feeling,
while the ballads are positively creamy
in their warmth, as can be easily dis-
cerned from this recording. Hop on
board for this tour with Les Elgart
and his orchestra, and you will swiftly
discover why they have consistently
ranked at the top of popularity polls
and best-seller lists; discover, in fact,
the most rewarding dance music to be
heard anywhere these days.
This Columbia High Fidelity recording is scientifically designed to play with the highest quality of reproduction on the phonograph of your choice, new or old. If you are the
owner of
a new stereophonic system, this record will play with even more brilliant true-to-life fidelity. In short, you can purchase this record with no fear of its becoming obsolete in the future.
